notes: Landscape template. The left side sits just right of the thick vertical bar that rules off the title strip (ZONING MAP OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO, legend, sheet number), README rule 3; the bar's map-side edge drifts from x ~1104 at the top to ~1091 at the bottom. Top, right and bottom sit just inside the single frame rule (rule 1). Each side's inner edge was measured column by column, smoothed with a robust local-linear fit, and the outline set ~1.5 px inside it, points every ~50-250 px; corners where the fitted sides meet. The ZONING MAP INDEX inset (ruled box x 5227-6316, y 3745-4948; ~140 px clear of the right rule and ~160 px clear of the bottom rule, open bay between) is a ruled box at the margin (rule 3): cut out as a notch together with the paper between it and the frame, the outline running ~4 px outside its top rule (y 3741) from the right rule and ~4 px outside its left rule (x 5223) down to the bottom rule. No holes (rule 4): 'SEE SHEET 2' (top, above the piers) and 'SEE SHEET 8' (vertical, just right of the title bar) are floating cross-references with no box, so they are inside. No SECTION badge (the sheet number is in the title strip); the north arrow and scale bar are in the title strip too, so outside, and there is no remove polygon. Little ink is left under the outline: a small mark and a tick touching the bottom and top rules (kind b) and specks on the top rule's edge. PIER HEAD LINE, THE EMBARCADERO, SAN FRANCISCO BAY and district codes are map.
